reason_linters_not_run: Ruff and Mypy were not run because a cache outside the G.14.9 directory could not be ruled out. G.14.8 already recorded their results. This stage does not claim a new lint result.

commands.purpose: hash the authorised baseline files, recompute canonical G.7 and G.10 manifest digests, recompute the staging manifest digest, and call tests/g14_1_verify.py verify_directory

limitations: No Windows security API was called.

Docker, WSL, and hypervisor capabilities were not inspected.
The running container was not refreshed.
